# Security Policy

## Supported versions
This project is maintained on a best-effort basis. Security fixes, if made, will generally target the latest version on the default branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability
Please **do not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

Preferred reporting methods:
1. Use GitHub Security Advisories ("Report a vulnerability") if enabled for this repository.
2. Otherwise, privately contact the repository owner/maintainer (email).

Include, if possible:
- A clear description of the issue and potential impact
- Steps to reproduce / proof-of-concept (as safe as possible)
- Affected platforms (web/android/ios/windows)
- Suggested fix or mitigation (optional)

## Disclosure
We’ll acknowledge receipt when we can and coordinate a fix/release timeline depending on severity and maintainer availability.
